slides.question: Fill a table in *one statement* (ABAP 7.40)?
slides.voiceover: Seven forty syntax में, एक ही statement में table कैसे भरोगे? सोचो।
slides.spoken: Seven forty syntax mein, ek hi statement mein table kaise bharoge? Socho.

slides.heading: Answer: *VALUE #( )*
slides.code:
lt_items = VALUE #(
  ( matnr = 'MAT-01' menge = 10 )
  ( matnr = 'MAT-02' menge = 5 ) ).
slides.voiceover: Answer है VALUE. हर row अपने brackets में, कोई APPEND नहीं।
slides.spoken: Answer hai VALUE. Har row apne brackets mein, koi APPEND nahi.

slides.title: Follow for *daily ABAP*
slides.body: One modern ABAP trick every day.
slides.voiceover: ऐसी tricks के लिए follow करो।
slides.spoken: Aisi tricks ke liye follow karo.

posts.caption:
Quick quiz: how do you fill an internal table in a single statement?

Since ABAP 7.40, the VALUE operator builds the whole table inline. Each row goes in its own brackets, so there is no work area and no APPEND.

It also works for structures, nested tables and with BASE to add rows to an existing table.

Did you get it right? Tell me in the comments.

More 7.40 syntax tricks are in the ABAP Code Vault (link in bio).
